p.src: It was not until late that afternoon that Darrow could claim his postponed hour with Anna. p.src: The feeling that both resistance and apprehension were vain was working like wine in his veins. p.src: Effie, emboldened by the privileges of the evening, was for coaxing Owen to round it off with a game of forfeits or some such reckless climax; but Sophy, resuming her professional role, sounded the summons to bed. In her pupil’s wake she made her round of good-nights; but when she proffered her hand to Anna, the latter ignoring the gesture held out both arms.

p.src: “Good-night, dear child,” she said impulsively, and drew the girl to her kiss.
